scope: Only the Verified Tool Calls claim contained in the exact sealed long_horizon source blob: a reported medium-fault ablation compares retry-only, verification-only, and verify-before-retry; verification-only reportedly outperforms retry-only and the combined arm is not monotonically best, but the experiment lacks the verification-OFF/recovery-OFF cell and the implementation separately retries rate-limited LLM-client responses up to five times. This grade therefore covers a bounded verification-versus-retry interaction signal and a retry-locus confound warning, not a complete four-cell causal factorial or a zero-Work, zero-quota, zero-cost Chat-native route. AID-Guard claims in the same source blob are excluded.

independent_checks.logical_consistency_result: The sealed claim is internally coherent as a methodological warning. A three-arm comparison can show that verification and retry are not interchangeable and that their combination is not uniformly monotone, but without a no-verification/no-recovery control it cannot identify the full factorial interaction. Separately retried LLM-client failures mean a nominal recovery-off arm can still contain physical retry unless every retry locus is explicitly disabled or held fixed.

grading.causal_attribution: moderate_to_low; the missing verification-OFF/recovery-OFF cell prevents a complete factorial interaction estimate and separate client-level retry is a material treatment-contamination risk
grading.reproducibility: low_to_moderate_for_independent_replay_in_this_slice; the sealed source reports implementation behavior but this bounded grade did not verify a trustworthy official public runner or independently reproduce the ablation
grading.primary_source_support: moderate_by_exact sealed-source citation and claim transcription; direct primary-source refetch was intentionally not added to this single-effect chain
grading.uncertainty: Useful as a narrow retry-locus accounting and experiment-design guard. It does not establish a full verification-by-recovery causal factorial, independent replication, zero optional-quota operation, zero incremental cost, or a complete Chat-native dependency-elimination route.

gates.zero_work_or_protected_manual_dependency: not_established_for_candidate_route; this record grades an interaction/confound claim rather than a complete dependency-elimination route

phase1_acceptance_boundary: Verified Tool Calls contributes bounded evidence that a recovery-off evaluation is invalid if retry remains active at any hidden locus and that verification-only, retry-only, and combined behavior should not be collapsed into one treatment. Any accepted Phase-1 parity experiment must enumerate and control agent-loop, SDK/client, gateway/provider, whole-run restart/redelivery, resume, and rewind retry loci and include the missing no-verification/no-recovery control when claiming a verification-by-recovery interaction. This candidate does not itself eliminate Work/protected/manual execution, prove zero finite-quota operation, prove zero incremental cost, satisfy zero-quota/rate-limit replay, cover all current managed-role cells, or close the Phase-1 root.
